Agenda #1: Shareholders approved the 2025 Annual Report and the Directors' accountability report for the fiscal year ending December 31, 2025. The decision included the oversight report from the Board of Commissioners and covered the company's operations for the year.
Agenda #2: The meeting ratified the 2025 financial statements audited by RSM Indonesia and granted full discharge to the Board for their management and oversight. It was also resolved that no dividends would be distributed for the 2025 fiscal year.
Agenda #3: RSM Indonesia was appointed to audit the 2026 financial statements, with authority granted to the Board to determine honorariums and appointment terms. The Board of Commissioners is delegated to handle appointments or dismissals based on Audit Committee recommendations.
Agenda #4: The meeting approved the end of terms for two commissioners and the appointment or reappointment of several board members until 2031. The final composition includes 6 members of the Board of Commissioners and 13 members of the Board of Directors.
Agenda #5: The Board of Commissioners was authorized to determine board remuneration and duties, while the Directors were empowered to execute all actions related to meeting decisions. This includes the authority to formalize board appointments via notarial deed based on committee recommendations.
Agenda #6: The company presented a report on the utilization of funds from Sustainable Bonds I BUMI (Phases I-V) issued in 2025 and 2026. No formal resolution was adopted as this agenda item was for reporting purposes only.
